messages:
maria.g: quick sync — finalizing the webinar launch assets and the PLG funnel experiment plan. goal: 1) webinar signups -> 2) promptpack trial -> 3) convert to paid by day 14. timeline: launch posts + benchmark narrative go live tues, webinar thurs. :rocket:
jon_k: sounds good. what's the hypothesis for the experiment?
priya.s: hypothesis = targeted free-credit segment (first-time builders with <=5 API calls) + promptpack follow-up increases activation by 2-3x vs generic credit nudge. key metric = activated users (used promptpack + >=1 api call in 48h).
ash: can we gate the promptpack CTA behind a quick quick-start flow? 2-min setup, pre-filled templates for embeddings + chat. reduces friction.
derek: love it. for the launch post narrative we should surface a benchmark: "real app, 50ms median token latency, 40% lower cost with batching" — that feels tangible to engineers. add a short GIF of workflow. :eyes:
priya.s: agree. need to make the benchmark claim reproducible — add a small snippet in the blog showing the exact config + model variant. eg:```bash
# config excerpt for bench
MODEL=redwood-2-small
SEQ=512
BATCH=16
QUANT=4bit
```
kai: routing note — inbound leads from the webinar landing page should be split 60/40 into: "starter-credit" cohort vs "promptpack-flow" cohort. tracking via UTMs and our webhook.
maria.g: here are the UTM patterns i mocked:```text
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=ignite-launch&utm_medium=social&utm_variant=promptpack
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=post&utm_campaign=ignite-launch&utm_medium=social&utm_variant=credit-only
```please confirm event names for analytics.
jon_k: event names: webinar_signup, promptpack_started, credit_claimed, activated_user. wire them into the dashboard. i'll add funnel steps in GA + internal dashboard. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
priya.s: email/webinar reminder A/B subject lines: A) "Build faster with low-latency inference — join our webinar" B) "Free credits + prompt templates — ship an LLM feature this week" which performs better?
ash: B engages PMs/engineers who want fast wins, A pulls platform-focused folks. let's A/B both but bias B to our seed cohort.
derek: follow-up sequence (after webinar): 1) day0: promptpack + 50 free credits, 2) day2: quickstart checklist, 3) day6: success template + invite to office hours. copy should be short and prompt-driven.
kai: for routing: webhook payload should include utm_variant and session_id, then we run short-lived canary routing — if promptpack_flow > 10% fewer activations at 24h fallback to credit-only. add an alert to #marketing if that happens.
growth-bot: deployed experiment config:
- cohorts: promptpack_flow (60%), credit_only (40%)
- metric: activated_user (48h)
- success delta target: +2.5% absolute
- alert channel: #marketing

maria.g: owners: content (priya + jon), product/engineering for promptpack quickstart (ash + derek), analytics (kai). deliverables by Monday EOD: launch post draft, benchmark appendix, tracked UTMs, email copy A/B, webhook schema.
priya.s: i'll upload draft to the doc and ping for review by monday. can someone take copy for the social posts? short bullets + 1 benchmark stat + CTA.
jon_k: i'll take social copy. planning to include code GIF + 2 CTA variants.
ash: engineering note — promptpack quickstart needs a one-click import and a small serverless example. estimating 2 dev days.
derek: i can carve out the serverless snippet. will prototype today.
kai: analytics will stub the dashboard and add the funnel. give me the event schema by EOD monday and i'll wire the webhooks.
maria.g: final ask — let's keep the messaging explicit about cost/economics (benchmarks) and speed to first successful query. that's our strongest hook for devs. :thumbsup:
jon_k: cool. i'll post the launch thread copy in #marketing-drafts for signoff.
priya.s: thanks all. if anyone wants to test subject lines, i can run a tiny seed send to 500 users tomorrow.
ash: sign me up for the seed.
maria.g: perfect. end of thread — will follow up with the deliverable checklist tomorrow morning.
